acceptance_rule.c: neither north nor south cohort regresses by >2%
acceptance_rule.e: no extended-event loss regression >5% -- satisfied by construction: every candidate leaves the 8 extended events at the frozen 0.5 weight, so their predictions are unchanged
acceptance_rule.f: any newly fitted parameter is cross-fitted leave-one-fold-out and additionally checked on a strict temporal split

trials.hypothesis: The global 0.5 was chosen on 6N-2025 LORO, never on this target. Refitting one global v4 weight on the historical folds should move it toward the all-rugby optimum.
trials.name: C1_global_weight
reasons: (a) stable_score 0.886763 did not improve on frozen 0.886470

trials.hypothesis: Empirical priors win on sparse/attacking events and the GBDT wins on dense volume events, so one weight per target should beat a single global weight. Highest overfitting risk in the queue.
trials.name: C2_per_target_weight

trials.hypothesis: The metric mixes Poisson deviance, log-squared, log-loss and MAE. One weight per loss family captures the structural split at a fraction of the variance of 24 free weights.
trials.name: C3_per_loss_family_weight

trials.hypothesis: Encode the density hypothesis directly: w(target) = clip(a + b * positive_rate, 0, 1), monotone in event density.
trials.name: C4_density_parametric_weight
reasons: (a) stable_score 0.886993 did not improve on frozen 0.886470

trials.hypothesis: Per-target weights shrunk toward the fitted global weight, with the shrinkage strength chosen by an inner leave-one-fold-out pass over the training folds only. Keeps C2's signal, discards its noise.
trials.name: C5_shrunk_per_target_weight

trials.hypothesis: The blend is on event MEANS, but the metric is Poisson deviance / log-squared, whose natural link is log. Blending every target on the log1p scale at the frozen 0.5 weight adds no fitted parameter.
trials.name: C6_log_space_all_targets

trials.hypothesis: If the log link is the right space for these losses, the per-target weight should be fitted there too rather than in mean space.
trials.name: C8_log_space_per_target_weight
